description.en: Switches the view to the given camera: it sets a request flag on that camera object, which the events use to make a camera loaded with CMND_LOAD_CAMERA the active one. Go back with CMND_POP_CAMERA. Nothing happens if the handle is not a camera.

examples.case: A camera animation for a match scene (real usage, from ev44010001.nut; the Shift-JIS object names are replaced by variables here)
